headword: {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}

definitions.explanation: A fee charged on top of the base price for extra services, options, or upgrades. Commonly encountered in travel, dining, and service industries.

examples.japanese: {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}はかかりますか。
{大盛|おおも}りにすると{追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}が{百|ひゃく}{円|えん}かかる。
examples.english: Getting a large portion costs an extra 100 yen.

examples.japanese: {座席|ざせき}の{指定|してい}には{追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}が{必要|ひつよう}ですので、ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: Please note that seat reservation requires an additional fee.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {追加|ついか} (addition) + {料金|りょうきん} (fee/charge). Very commonly used in everyday situations such as restaurants, hotels, transportation, and subscriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}がかかる: an extra charge applies
- {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}なしで: at no extra charge
- {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}が{発生|はっせい}する: an additional fee is incurred
- {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay an additional fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {割増|わりまし}{料金|りょうきん}: surcharge — specifically a percentage-based markup
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: handling fee — for processing or service
- {延長|えんちょう}{料金|りょうきん}: extension fee — for going over time
